resources.string: Estimates change the map display only. Recorded locations, distances and replay statistics keep their original values.
Road display is unavailable in this build. A routing provider and its privacy information must be configured first.
Turn on Network geocoding in Settings before enabling road display. Turning it off also stops road requests.

For the selected map range or outing, eligible recorded segment endpoints and travel modes are sent to %1$s to estimate a route. These coordinates can reveal where you have been. Up to 40 segments can be considered per preparation, with an alternate travel mode when needed.

Turn this off to cancel requests and discard derived routes from memory. No derived routes are saved in your history. Clearing history also turns this off. Coordinates already received by the provider cannot be recalled.
